lines.en: label streets15:
scene yumiapples1
I scout the area for Yumi as I make my way down the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 我一边沿着 Kumon-mi 的街道往前走，一边四处搜寻 Yumi 的身影。

lines.en: The middle of the afternoon is the peak-time for foot traffic over the weekend, so things are surprisingly busy right now.
lines.zh: 周末的午后是行人最多的高峰时段，所以这会儿热闹得出奇。

lines.en: There are women walking dogs, children playing too close to the street...and I'm pretty sure I even saw a man or two at some point.
lines.zh: 有遛狗的女人，有在离马路太近的地方玩耍的小孩……而且我敢肯定，某个瞬间我甚至还看见了一两个男人。

lines.en: That's a big deal when you remember that nearly all of them are millions of miles away right now.
lines.zh: 想到此刻他们几乎全都远在几百万英里之外，这可就相当了不起了。

lines.en: But Yumi is nowhere to be seen.
lines.zh: 可 Yumi 连个影子都没有。

lines.en: I wonder where she could be?...
lines.zh: 她到底能去哪儿呢？……

lines.en: scene yumiapples2
: If only there was some sort of clue as to where I could find her...
lines.zh: : 要是有什么线索能告诉我上哪儿找她就好了……

lines.en: : Hey. Captain Fuckwad. I’m right here.
lines.zh: : 嘿。混蛋船长。我就在这儿。

lines.en: : The hell you just starin’ off into space for?
lines.zh: : 你他妈盯着空气发什么呆？

lines.en: : Oh, wow. What an incredibly convenient turn of events.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。事情的发展还真是方便得离谱。

lines.en: : Are you ready to get going?
lines.zh: : 你准备好出发了吗？

lines.en: scene yumiapples3
: Get going? The fuck are you talkin’ about? I don’t remember makin’ any plans with you.
lines.zh: : 出发？你他妈在说什么？我不记得跟你约过什么。

lines.en: : Well, we didn’t really decide on a date, but I figured today might be a good chance to go scope out the cafe together.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们确实没定日子，但我觉得今天大概是个一起去那家咖啡厅踩点的好机会。

lines.en: scene yumiapples4
: Wait, today?! Why today?!
lines.zh: : 等等，今天？！为什么是今天？！

lines.en: : Don’t you need to like, get all dressed up and shit when you go job-hunting?
lines.zh: : 去找工作不是得好好打扮一下什么的吗？

lines.en: : Girls your age can normally get away with not doing that. Especially if it’s for something like a part time job as a barista.
lines.zh: : 你这个年纪的女孩通常不打扮也没问题。尤其是只是去当个兼职咖啡师之类的。

lines.en: : Besides, do you even have other clothes? That’s the only shirt I ever see you wear.
lines.zh: : 再说，你还有别的衣服吗？我就没见你换过别的衬衫。

lines.en: scene yumiapples5
: Of fucking course I have other clothes! I just like this shirt! You got a problem with that?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然有别的衣服！我只是喜欢这件！你有意见吗？！

lines.en: : No. I just don't think it's doing you any favors in the cuteness department.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是觉得它对你的“可爱度”没什么帮助。

lines.en: scene yumiapples6
: Well, good. That department fuckin’ sucks.
lines.zh: : 挺好。那个部门他妈最没劲了。

lines.en: : All those who spend hours every morning tryin’ to make themselves look pretty and shit are missin’ out on the joys of life.
lines.zh: : 每天早上花好几个小时把自己捯饬得漂漂亮亮的人，都错过了人生的乐趣。

lines.en: : Right. Because when I think ‘Yumi’ the first thing that comes to mind is the endless pursuit of happiness.
lines.zh: : 是啊。因为一想到“Yumi”，我脑子里第一个冒出来的就是对幸福的无尽追求。

lines.en: scene yumiapples7
: Hey! You’re lucky I need money or I’d never agree to doing somethin’ as stupid as this!
lines.zh: : 嘿！算你走运，我需要钱，不然我死也不会答应干这么蠢的事！

lines.en: : There is nothing stupid about joining the workforce, Yumi. Just look at me- a semi-successful man of indeterminate age living his best life.
lines.zh: : 加入劳动大军一点都不蠢，Yumi。看看我——一个年纪不明的半成功男人，正过着最棒的人生。

lines.en: scene yumiapples8
: {i}Indeterminate age{/i} my ass. You're old as fuck.
lines.zh: : {i}年纪不明{/i}个屁。你他妈老得要死。

lines.en: : Just...bring me to the stupid cafe already. I don’t remember how to get there.
lines.zh: : 行了……快带我去那家破咖啡厅吧。我不记得怎么走了。

lines.en: : Oh, cool. I was starting to think you were going to back down.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。我还以为你要打退堂鼓了呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, so was I...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我也以为……

lines.en: scene yumiapples9
: So, are we gonna fuckin’ get this over with or are you just going to keep standin’ there like one of those weird British guard dudes?
lines.zh: : 所以，我们他妈到底要不要赶紧把这事办完，还是你就打算继续像个英国卫兵似的站在这儿？

lines.en: : Fine, fine. Let’s go.
lines.zh: : 好好好。走吧。

lines.en: : If you try to run away, though, I’m grabbing you and dragging your body there myself.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是想跑，我就直接把你抓起来，亲自拖过去。

lines.en: : Lay a finger on me and I swear to God you’ll live the rest of your life without a dick.
lines.zh: : 你敢碰我一下，我发誓让你下半辈子都没鸡巴。

lines.en: scene black
scene jobint1
After a fair share of walking, the two of us arrive at the cafe.
lines.zh: 走了好一阵子，我们两个总算到了那家咖啡厅。

lines.en: "I think Rin should still be working, so the best course of action is probably
lines.zh: “我想 Rin 应该还在上班，所以最好的办法大概是

lines.en: just asking her about any potential openings."
lines.zh: 直接问问她有没有空缺。“

lines.en: scene jobint2
: Uhh...I’m having second thoughts about this.
lines.zh: : 呃……我开始有点后悔了。

lines.en: : Headphones is working right now. Won’t she think it’s weird if she sees the two of us together?
lines.zh: : 耳机妹这会儿在上班吧。她要是看到我们两个在一起，会不会觉得很奇怪？

lines.en: : Probably. But we're already here, so there's no backing down now.
lines.zh: : 大概会。不过我们都已经到这儿了，现在没法打退堂鼓了。

lines.en: : It’s just Rin, though. I doubt she’d make a big deal out of something like that.
lines.zh: : 可那是 Rin 啊。我怀疑她不会为这种事大惊小怪。

lines.en: : Well...you know her better than I do, I guess.
lines.zh: : 唉……反正你比我了解她，大概吧。

lines.en: scene jobint3
: Which is actually really fucking disturbing to say since I’m the same age as her and have known her at least twice as long.
lines.zh: : 说起来还真是他妈诡异，我明明跟她同岁，认识她的时间至少是你的两倍。

lines.en: : Uhh...Apples to apples, I guess?
lines.zh: : 呃……算是苹果对苹果吧？

lines.en: scene jobint4
: How does that dumb-ass phrase even apply here?!
lines.zh: : 这他妈什么蠢话跟这儿有什么关系？！

lines.en: : It doesn’t. Just open the goddamn door, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 没关系。赶紧把门给我打开，Yumi。

lines.en: : Do it for the money. And the lunch. And m-
lines.zh: : 为了钱。为了午饭。还有为了我——

lines.en: scene jobint5
: If you tell me to do it for you I’m going to walk away right now.
lines.zh: : 你要是敢说为了你，我现在就走。

lines.en: : Do it for the money. And the lunch.
lines.zh: : 为了钱。为了午饭。

lines.en: : Ugh...whatever...
lines.zh: : 啧……随便吧……

lines.en: scene black
Instead of moving toward the door, Yumi steps behind me and uses me as a sort of body-shield.
lines.zh: Yumi 没有朝门口走，反而躲到我身后，把我当成了某种人肉盾牌。

lines.en: We’re walking into a cafe, not some sort of gang hideout, so I’m not sure what the big deal is.
lines.zh: 我们进的是咖啡厅，又是什么黑帮据点，我真搞不懂有什么大不了的。

lines.en: But either way, I push aside the doors and the two of us make our way inside of the pleasantly air conditioned building.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我推开大门，两人走进了这栋空调开得十分宜人的建筑。

lines.en: For me, this is nothing but a welcome escape from the heat.
lines.zh: 对我来说，这不过是逃离酷暑的一处美好避难所。

lines.en: But for Yumi-
lines.zh: 但对 Yumi 来说——

lines.en: This is a huge step toward the {i}her{/i} she's always dreamt of.
lines.zh: 这是朝着{i}她{/i}一直梦想的“那个自己”迈出的一大步。

lines.en: Or not and she's just desperate.
lines.zh: 也可能不是，她只是走投无路罢了。

lines.en: Either way, I'm glad to be inside again.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，能重新待在室内我还是很高兴的。

lines.en: scene jobint6
: Hey, Sensei! You don’t normally come in-
lines.zh: : 嘿，Sensei！你平时不会在这个点——

lines.en: scene jobint7
: This late...
lines.zh: : 来的……

lines.en: : Yo.
Rin’s enthusiasm immediately vanishes as soon as Yumi walks up to the counter with me.
lines.zh: Yumi 跟我一起走到柜台前，Rin 的热情瞬间就消失了。

lines.en: I can only imagine how confusing that must be, especially with how Yumi and I rarely even talk at[school].
lines.zh: 我能想象那有多让人摸不着头脑，尤其是我和 Yumi 在[school]里几乎都不怎么说话。

lines.en: Well, Yumi rarely talks to {i}anyone{/i} at[school] on account of not being there, but I digress.
lines.zh: 好吧，Yumi 在[school]里几乎不跟“{i}任何人{/i}”说话，因为人根本不在那儿，不过扯远了。

lines.en: : Oh. Uh...Hey, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……嘿，Yumi。

lines.en: : Sup, Headphones.
lines.zh: : 哟，耳机妹。

lines.en: scene jobint8
: Uhh...Sensei?
lines.zh: : 呃……Sensei？

lines.en: : Yeah?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : Would it be weird for me to ask exactly what's going on here?
lines.zh: : 我要是问一句这到底是怎么回事，会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: : I think it would be perfectly reasonable to ask that, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得问这个完全合情合理，Rin。

lines.en: : Then, what exactly is going on here?
lines.zh: : 那这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : Since when do you and Yumi, like...go out for coffee?
lines.zh: : 你和 Yumi 从什么时候开始……一起出去喝咖啡了？

lines.en: : It's our first date and she's very nervous. Please don't say anything that will embarrass her.
lines.zh: : 这是我们的第一次约会，她紧张得不行。请别说任何会让她难堪的话。

lines.en: scene jobint9
: Yo! That ain't even close to bein' funny! Don't go sayin' shit like-
lines.zh: : 喂！这他妈一点都不好笑！你别乱说这种——

lines.en: : Yumi, quiet. Don't raise your voice like that in a place you're about to apply to.
lines.zh: : Yumi，安静。在你马上要应聘的地方别那么大声。

lines.en: scene jobint10
: Wait...apply? Are you looking for a job?
lines.zh: : 等等……应聘？你在找工作？

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, yeah.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，对。

lines.en: : I...kinda need the cash, so...
lines.zh: : 我……有点缺钱，所以……

lines.en: : Okay, but...Why here of all places? I didn’t even know you liked coffee.
lines.zh: : 好，可是……为什么偏偏是这儿？我都不知道你喜欢咖啡。

lines.en: : I don’t.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢。

lines.en: scene jobint11
: Oh. Well, uhh...I guess there's technically no rule saying you {i}have{/i} to like coffee to work here, but...
lines.zh: : 哦。那个，呃……我想严格来说也没有规定说你“{i}必须{/i}”喜欢咖啡才能在这儿打工，不过……

lines.en: : Yeah. You know, I'm still not really getting why you chose here when that's...basically all we sell.
lines.zh: : 是啊。你看，我还是不太明白你为什么选这儿，毕竟那……基本上就是我们唯一卖的东西。

lines.en: : I’ll take responsibility for that, Rin.
lines.zh: : 这个我来负责解释，Rin。

lines.en: : We couldn't figure out where to go and this place was just the first one that came to mind.
lines.zh: : 我们想不出该去哪儿，这儿就是我们第一个想到的地方。

lines.en: scene jobint12
: Wait, so you two like, {i}planned{/i} this?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以你们两个是“{i}计划{/i}”好的？

lines.en: : In a sense, yeah. I’m basically just going to take Yumi around and force her to apply to everywhere I can think of so that she doesn’t have to keep selling old TV’s until she dies.
lines.zh: : 某种意义上，是的。我基本就是要带着 Yumi 到处跑，逼她去我能想到的每一家店应聘，好让她不用一直卖旧电视卖到死。

lines.en: : Uhh...Okay, well...first off, what?
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧，那个……首先，什么？

lines.en: : And secondly-
lines.zh: : 其次——

lines.en: scene jobint13
: {i}What?{/i}
: That’s a fair reaction. I can imagine it's probably really weird seeing the two of us together like this out of seemingly nowhere.
lines.zh: : 这反应很正常。我能想象，看到我们两个突然就这么凑在一起，大概确实挺怪的。

lines.en: : Ain't just {i}seemingly{/i}. It's literally nowhere. I hate being around you, remember?
lines.zh: : 不只是“{i}看起来{/i}”怪。根本就是毫无来由。我讨厌跟你待在一起，记得吗？

lines.en: : Again, yes. Thanks, Yumi.
lines.zh: : 又说一遍，是啊。谢了，Yumi。

lines.en: scene jobint12
: {i}Weird{/i} would be an understatement, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 光说“{i}怪{/i}”都算轻的了，Sensei。

lines.en: : You know that baby in a jar that Norman Reedus has to carry around in Death Stranding? This is like that, but somehow even weirder.
lines.zh: : 你知道《死亡搁浅》里 Norman Reedus 得随身带着的那个装在罐子里的婴儿吗？这就像那样，但不知怎么还要更怪。

lines.en: : Than a baby in a jar?
lines.zh: : 比装在罐子里的婴儿还怪？

lines.en: : Than a baby in a jar.
lines.zh: : 比装在罐子里的婴儿还怪。

lines.en: : I'm gonna go ahead and interrupt whatever the fuck is happening here to remind you two that I'm here to make money.
lines.zh: : 我打断一下你们这他妈到底在聊什么，提醒你们两位，我是来挣钱的。

lines.en: scene jobint14
: Yeah, so, I’m not really sure if we’re hiring, but I can go grab my manager from the back if you wanna go take a seat near the door.
lines.zh: : 行吧，那个，我也不太确定我们到底招不招人，不过我可以去后面把经理叫来，你们先靠门那边坐会儿吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, sure. Do I need to like, fill something out or whatever?
lines.zh: : 行，好。我需要填个什么表之类的吗？

lines.en: : Nah. She’ll probs just wanna talk to you or something. She’s chill. Huge boobs, too.
lines.zh: : 不用。她大概就想跟你聊两句什么的。她人很随和。胸还特别大。

lines.en: scene jobint15
: Uhh...cool?
lines.zh: : 呃……不错？

lines.en: : Frickin' {i}gigantic.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他妈的“{i}巨大无比{/i}”。

lines.en: : I just don’t want you to feel threatened by her womanly presence.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想让你被她那股女人味吓到。

lines.en: : ...Yeah, I think I'll be okay.
lines.zh: : ……行，我觉得我应该没事。

lines.en: : Anyway, hang tight for a sec. I'll go get her.
lines.zh: : 总之，你稍等一下。我去叫她。

lines.en: scene jobint16
: Why is everyone in our class so fucking weird?
lines.zh: : 我们班的人为什么一个个都他妈这么怪？

lines.en: : Oh, come on. Rin isn’t that bad.
lines.zh: : 行了别闹了。Rin 没那么糟。

lines.en: : Doesn’t she like, collect skulls and shit?
lines.zh: : 她不是喜欢收集什么骷髅头之类的吗？

lines.en: scene black
: Fair point.
lines.zh: : 有道理。

lines.en: I guess Yumi understands that she's about to be interviewed, so she walks directly past me and makes her way over to a chair in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: Yumi 大概是明白自己马上要被面试了，所以径直从我身边走过，走到房间角落的一张椅子旁坐下。

lines.en: I try to follow her but she waves me off and I’m forced to go sit at a different table and wait for her to finish.
lines.zh: 我想跟过去，可她挥手把我赶开，我只好在另一张桌子边坐下，等她结束。

lines.en: Thankfully, I’m able to grab a seat that makes it easy to listen in once Haruka comes out of her office...
lines.zh: 幸好我挑的座位很方便偷听，等 Haruka 从办公室出来后就能听得一清二楚……

lines.en: scene jobint17
Haruka sits down beside Yumi after Rin points her out.
lines.zh: Rin 指了指 Yumi，Haruka 便在她旁边坐下。

lines.en: "Yumi, who had been sitting straight up just moments ago, begins to noticeably lose her
lines.zh: “就在几分钟前还坐得笔直的 Yumi，在 Haruka 坐下的那一刻，

lines.en: composure as soon as Haruka sits down."
lines.zh: 明显开始失去镇定。“

lines.en: Job interviews are always intimidating, but the first few are normally ten times worse.
lines.zh: 求职面试总是让人紧张，但头几次通常会糟上十倍。

lines.en: Oh well. It’s out of my hands now.
lines.zh: 算了。现在也不由我了。

lines.en: From this point on, it's up to Yumi to either take her fate into her own two hands-
lines.zh: 从这一刻起，要么 Yumi 用自己的双手抓住命运——

lines.en: Or let it slip through her fingers like an...old TV that's too heavy to carry or something.
lines.zh: 要么就让它从指缝里溜走，像一台……重得搬不动的旧电视之类的。

lines.en: It's not my best metaphor, but it's topical and gets the job done.
lines.zh: 这不是我最好的比喻，但很应景，也够用了。

lines.en: Unlike Yumi.
lines.zh: 不像 Yumi。

lines.en: Who doesn't have a job.
lines.zh: 她连工作都没有。

lines.en: Okay, I'm done now.
lines.zh: 好了，我说完了。

lines.en: : So, you're Yumi Yamaguchi, right? Rin said you’re a classmate of hers.
lines.zh: : 那么，你就是 Yumi Yamaguchi，对吧？Rin 说你是她的同学。

lines.en: : Oh, y-yeah! We’ve been in a few classes together, actually.
lines.zh: : 哦，对、对！其实我们一起上过好几门课。

lines.en: : Going back to like...middle[school], I think?
lines.zh: : 大概要追溯到……初中[school]的时候？

lines.en: : Oh, really? That's great.
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？那挺好的。

lines.en: : I'm not sure how much she's told you about this place, but pretty much all of our employees go to your school.
lines.zh: : 我不知道她跟你讲过多少这家店的事，不过我们这儿的员工基本都来自你们学校。

lines.en: : And if you’re any bit as good as she is at this job, I can definitely see things working out for you here.
lines.zh: : 要是你能有她一半干得好，我敢肯定你在这儿会干得很不错。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah. I'll do what I can.
lines.zh: : 那个……嗯。我会尽力的。

lines.en: : Do you have any experience in customer service, Yumi?
lines.zh: : Yumi，你有做客服的经验吗？

lines.en: scene jobint18
: Um...Not really. Sorry...
lines.zh: : 嗯……基本没有。抱歉……

lines.en: scene jobint19
: You don’t need to apologize. You’re still young. It’s perfectly fine if you haven’t had a job yet.
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉。你还年轻。没工作过再正常不过了。

lines.en: : I didn't have my first job until after high school, so you're already ahead of the me from back then and I like to think I turned out pretty okay.
lines.zh: : 我高中毕业之后才有第一份工作，所以你已经比那时候的我领先了，而我自认为后来混得还不错。

lines.en: : Crippling loneliness aside.
lines.zh: : 除了那要命的孤独之外。

lines.en: : You know what? How about I ask you something else, instead?
lines.zh: : 这样吧，我换个问题问你，怎么样？

lines.en: scene jobint20
: Oh, sure. Yeah. Ask whatever you want.
lines.zh: : 哦，好啊。行。你随便问。

lines.en: : Okay, so...how about a little work-related scenario?
lines.zh: : 那好，我们……来个和工作有关的小情景题吧？

lines.en: : I'll give you a situation that might arise while you’re at work, and you'll tell me what you’d do to remedy it.
lines.zh: : 我会给你一个上班时可能出现的状况，你来告诉我你会怎么解决。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Great! So, imagine you’re ringing a customer up.
lines.zh: : 很好！那么，想象你正在给客人结账。

lines.en: : Uh-huh.
lines.zh: : 嗯哼。

lines.en: : He buys a pastry for 100 yen and pays with a 500 yen coin.
lines.zh: : 他买了一份 100 日元的点心，付了一枚 500 日元的硬币。

lines.en: scene jobint21
: Hold on, I’m not asking about the change.
lines.zh: : 等等，我不是在问找零。

lines.en: : Oh, my bad. Go on.
lines.zh: : 哦，我的错。您继续。

lines.en: scene jobint20
: After you hand the customer his change back, he looks at it and says that you’re short 100 yen.
lines.zh: : 你把找零递给客人之后，他看了看，说你少给了 100 日元。

lines.en: scene jobint22
: Wait, so the dude pays with 500 yen and wants 500 yen back as his change?
lines.zh: : 等等，所以那家伙付了 500 日元，却想要 500 日元的找零？

lines.en: : Isn’t that one of those ‘confuse the cashier’ scams?
lines.zh: : 那不就是那种“糊弄收银员”的骗局吗？

lines.en: : Exactly! I’m surprised that you know about something like that despite never working in retail.
lines.zh: : 没错！你从没干过零售，居然还知道这种事，真让我意外。

lines.en: scene jobint23
: Hahah, yeaaah...Weird...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈，是啊……巧了……

lines.en: Something about that face tells me exactly why Yumi knows about things like that...
lines.zh: 她那副表情让我一下就明白，Yumi 为什么会知道这种事……

lines.en: Can’t say I’m all that surprised, though.
lines.zh: 不过我也说不上多惊讶。

lines.en: : So, what would you do in that situation?
lines.zh: : 那么，你会怎么做？

lines.en: scene jobint24
: Oh, easy!
lines.zh: : 哦，简单！

lines.en: : I’d punch his fucking teeth in.
lines.zh: : 我会把他那该死的牙打掉。

lines.en: : Ain’t no dude scamming any place I work for. Messin’ with the business is like messin’ with me.
lines.zh: : 在我打工的地方，没人能坑得了我。动这店的脑筋就是动我的脑筋。

lines.en: : Oh, and if any blood got on the counter or something, I’d be sure to use bleach to make sure all of it gets out.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，要是血溅到柜台上什么的，我一定会用漂白水把血迹全清干净。

lines.en: : A...clean workplace is a happy workplace or however it goes. Right?
lines.zh: : “干净的工作场所才是快乐的工作场所”，大概是这样说的吧？对吧？

lines.en: scene jobint25
: That was a good answer, right?
lines.zh: : 这是个好答案，对吧？

lines.en: : Mhm. Yup.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯。对。

lines.en: : In fact, I think I've actually heard all I need to hear.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我觉得我已经听到所有需要听的了。

lines.en: : Woah! That was like, totally quick! Does this mean I have the job?!
lines.zh: : 哇！这也太快了吧！是不是说明我被录用了？！

lines.en: scene jobint26
: You know what? How about I call you and let you know?...
lines.zh: : 这样吧，我回头打电话通知你，怎么样？……

lines.en: scene black
scene jobint27
: Yo! Did you hear that? She said she’s going to call me!
lines.zh: : 哟！你听到了吗？她说会打电话给我！

lines.en: : Yes, Yumi. I heard.
lines.zh: : 听到了，Yumi。我听到了。

lines.en: : Loud and clear.
lines.zh: : 听得清清楚楚。

lines.en: : Hey, do I still get lunch even though the job thing was successful on the first try?
lines.zh: : 嘿，虽然找工作一次就成功了，午饭还能照吃不误吧？

lines.en: : Of course...
lines.zh: : 当然……

lines.en: : Please buy as much as you like in...{i}celebration{/i} of your first interview...
lines.zh: : 请尽情买吧，就当是“{i}庆祝{/i}”你的第一次面试……

lines.en: scene black
Maybe taking her out job hunting before teaching her about appropriate social conduct wasn’t exactly the best idea?
lines.zh: 也许在教她什么叫得体的社交礼仪之前就带她出来找工作，并不是个好主意？

lines.en: This...is my fault.
lines.zh: 这……是我的错。

lines.en: I will take the blame for this.
lines.zh: 这个锅我来背。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Haruka.
lines.zh: 对不起，Haruka。

lines.en: I’m sorry, Yumi.
lines.zh: 对不起，Yumi。

lines.en: I’m sorry, everyone.
lines.zh: 对不起，所有人。

lines.en: $ streets15 = True
$ yumi_love += 1
{i}Yumi’s affection has increased to [yumi_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Yumi 的好感度提升到了 [yumi_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
